rules.statement: A party who is dissatisfied with an arbitral award and who wishes to challenge such award must make an application to set aside such award in terms of Section 32(1) of the Act.
rules.supporting_quote: A party who is dissatisfied with an arbitral award and who wishes to challenge such award must make an application to set aside such award in terms of Section 32(1) of the Act;
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 32(1) of the Arbitration Act, No. 11 of 1995
